description: This file contains extension methods for syntax generation and analysis within the Orleans code generator, specifically handling symbol syntax and constant expressions.

classes.name: SymbolSyntaxExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for syntax generation related to symbols and constants in the Orleans code generator.

methods.name: GetBindingFlagsParenthesizedExpressionSyntax
methods.description: Creates a parenthesized binary expression syntax combining multiple BindingFlags with a specified operation kind.

methods.name: ToExpression
methods.description: Converts a TypedConstant to an ExpressionSyntax, handling null, type, enum, and array constants.

methods.name: DisplayEnumConstant
methods.description: Decodes an enum constant into an ExpressionSyntax, combining flags with bitwise OR if necessary.

methods.name: ConvertToUInt64
methods.description: Converts various numeric types to ulong for comparison and bitwise operations.
